1.consolidated_definition: Árbol tropical de hasta 15 m de altura, de hojas oblongas lanceoladas, flores pequeñas verdosas y fruto capsular con semillas. (Salicaceae; Casearia arborea).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tropical tree reaching up to 15 meters in height, with oblong lanceolate leaves, small greenish flowers, and a capsular fruit containing seeds (Salicaceae; Casearia arborea).
